message.reasoning:
I'm ready to play Monopoly.

I'm weighing whether to buy Reading Railroad or start an auction. I have $1012 and four properties. The other players have different holdings and cash levels.

Reading Railroad costs $200. I own no railroads yet. p1 has Short Line and p2 has Pennsylvania. I need to keep cash liquid for Marvin ($280), New York ($200), and Vermont ($100). The light blue group is now split three ways.

I would have $812 left after buying Reading Railroad. That would leave only B&O unowned among railroads. I could then build a two-railroad path. This would block others from monopolizing the group and generate steady income.

Vermont is no longer a priority since p3 owns it. I still have enough cash for Marvin and New York. Auctioning would risk letting p1 or p2 buy it cheaply to complete their railroad sets. I should probably just buy it.
